-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [DetalleDocumento] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_DetalleDocumento_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Documento_Id AS INT = 0, 
@ConceptoFacturable_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @DetalleDocumentoFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		DetalleDocumento_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @DetalleDocumentoFilter (DetalleDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[DetalleDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[DetalleDocumento]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[DetalleDocumento].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @DetalleDocumentoFilter (DetalleDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[DetalleDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[DetalleDocumento]
		WHERE
			 (([DetalleDocumento].[Documento_Id] = @Documento_Id) OR (@Documento_Id = 0)) AND
         (([DetalleDocumento].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = @ConceptoFacturable_Id) OR (@ConceptoFacturable_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[DetalleDocumento].[Id],
		[DetalleDocumento].[Documento_Id],
		[DetalleDocumento].[ConceptoFacturable_Id],		
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto] AS [ConceptoFacturableConcepto],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Descripcion] AS [ConceptoFacturableDescripcion],
		[dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Unidad] as UnidadConcepto,
		[DetalleDocumento].[Unidades],		
		[DetalleDocumento].[PrecioUnitario],
		[DetalleDocumento].[Total],
		[dbo].[DetalleDocumento].[Unidad] as UnidadDetalle
		
	FROM @DetalleDocumentoFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[DetalleDocumento] 
			ON [DetalleDocumento].[Id] = filter.[DetalleDocumento_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Documento]
		ON [dbo].[DetalleDocumento].[Documento_Id] = [dbo].[Documento].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		ON [dbo].[DetalleDocumento].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_DetalleDocumento_Index]
Name: rpt_DetalleDocumento_Index
